description: This file defines the AttendanceRecord entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing attendance punch-in and punch-out data, with properties for timestamps, notes, timezone info, and relationships to employees.

classes.name: AttendanceRecord
classes.description: Entity class for storing attendance punch record data within the OrangeHRM system, with constants for states, properties for timestamps, notes, timezone data, and an employee relationship.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the attendance record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the attendance record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee associated with this attendance record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an employee with this attendance record.

methods.name: getPunchInUtcTime
methods.description: Retrieves the punch-in time in UTC.

methods.name: setPunchInUtcTime
methods.description: Sets the punch-in time in UTC.

methods.name: getPunchInNote
methods.description: Retrieves the note associated with the punch-in.

methods.name: setPunchInNote
methods.description: Sets the note for the punch-in.

methods.name: getPunchInTimeOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the timezone offset at punch-in.

methods.name: setPunchInTimeOffset
methods.description: Sets the timezone offset at punch-in.

methods.name: getPunchInUserTime
methods.description: Gets the user-local punch-in time.

methods.name: setPunchInUserTime
methods.description: Sets the user-local punch-in time.

methods.name: getPunchOutUtcTime
methods.description: Retrieves the punch-out time in UTC.

methods.name: setPunchOutUtcTime
methods.description: Sets the punch-out time in UTC.

methods.name: getPunchOutNote
methods.description: Retrieves the note associated with punch-out.

methods.name: setPunchOutNote
methods.description: Sets the note for punch-out.

methods.name: getPunchOutTimeOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the timezone offset at punch-out.

methods.name: setPunchOutTimeOffset
methods.description: Sets the timezone offset at punch-out.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserTime
methods.description: Gets the user-local punch-out time.

methods.name: setPunchOutUserTime
methods.description: Sets the user-local punch-out time.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the attendance record.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the attendance record.

methods.name: getPunchInTimezoneName
methods.description: Gets the timezone name at punch-in.

methods.name: setPunchInTimezoneName
methods.description: Sets the timezone name at punch-in.

methods.name: getPunchOutTimezoneName
methods.description: Gets the timezone name at punch-out.

methods.name: setPunchOutTimezoneName
methods.description: Sets the timezone name at punch-out.
